ts.1.body2:
Contact for data protection matters:
Martin Brandt
Email: martin.brandt@findera.fi
Phone: +358 50 336 3233
ts.1.body2.description: Privacy policy, item 1 — body text, 2nd paragraph. Contains HTML markup (e.g. <em> or <strong>). Keep the tags as they are and change only the text between them.
ts.2.title: 2. What Data We Process
ts.2.body: We process the information submitted through our contact form. Name and email address are required. Organisation name and phone number are optional and do not need to be provided. The form also lets you select which service your enquiry relates to and include a free-text message.
ts.3.title: 3. Purpose and Legal Basis for Processing
ts.3.body1: We use this information solely to respond to your enquiry — for example, to provide a quote, information about a project, or answer any other question you raise.
ts.3.body1.description: Privacy policy, item 3 — body text, 1st paragraph.
ts.3.body2: The legal basis for this processing is legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) of the General Data Protection Regulation, GDPR): we have a legitimate need to process your contact details in order to respond to the enquiry you have submitted. Processing is limited to this purpose.
ts.3.body2.description: Privacy policy, item 3 — body text, 2nd paragraph.
ts.4.title: 4. How Long We Keep Your Data
ts.4.body: We retain your data for up to 24 months from your last contact with us, after which it is deleted unless there is another basis for retaining it (for example, an ongoing client relationship or a legal obligation, such as accounting requirements in case of invoicing).
ts.5.title: 5. Do We Share Your Data With Third Parties
ts.5.body1: We do not share your data with third parties for marketing or other purposes.
ts.5.body1.description: Privacy policy, item 5 — body text, 1st paragraph.
ts.5.body2: We use Netlify (Netlify, Inc., United States) to technically operate our contact form; Netlify acts as our data processor. This means data submitted through the form passes through Netlify's infrastructure, which may involve transferring data outside the European Economic Area. Such transfers rely on safeguards recognised by the European Commission (such as Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, where the provider is certified under it). We do not use any other third-party services to process your data.
ts.5.body2.description: Privacy policy, item 5 — body text, 2nd paragraph.
ts.6.title: 6. Cookies
ts.6.body: Our website does not use analytics, marketing, or other non-essential cookies. The LinkedIn link on our site is a standard hyperlink and does not set any cookies unless you click it and are taken to LinkedIn.
ts.7.title: 7. Your Rights
ts.7.li1: request access to your personal data
ts.7.li4: object to processing or request that it be restricted
ts.7.body1: You can exercise these rights by emailing martin.brandt@findera.fi. We will respond to your request within a reasonable time.
ts.7.body1.description: Privacy policy, item 7 — body text, 1st paragraph. Contains HTML markup (e.g. <em> or <strong>). Keep the tags as they are and change only the text between them.
ts.7.body2: If you believe your data has been processed unlawfully, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Finnish Data Protection Ombudsman (tietosuoja.fi).
ts.7.body2.description: Privacy policy, item 7 — body text, 2nd paragraph. Contains HTML markup (e.g. <em> or <strong>). Keep the tags as they are and change only the text between them.
ts.8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
ts.8.body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date of the latest update is shown at the top of this page.
